```{r}

prior_table <- read_csv("파라미터_UBOIN.csv")

get_priors <- function(prior_table, scenario_name, candidate_num = 1) {
  # 컬럼 이름 구성
  mean_col <- paste0("Cand", candidate_num, "_mean(min,a)")
  sd_col  <- paste0("Cand", candidate_num, "_sd(max,b)")

  # 해당 시나리오 필터
  sub_df <- filter(prior_table, Scenario == scenario_name)

  # prior list
  E_prior <- list()
  T_prior <- list()

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(sub_df))) {
    param <- sub_df$Param[i]
    dist  <- sub_df$Dist[i]
    mean_val <- sub_df[[mean_col]][i]
    sd_val  <- sub_df[[sd_col]][i]

    ## Efficacy 파라미터 처리
    if (param %in% c("delta0", "delta1", "b0", "b1")) {
      if (dist == "Beta") {
        # Beta(shape1 = a, shape2 = b)
        # NOTE: 이 때는 mean = a/(a+b), var = ab/((a+b)^2*(a+b+1)) 이므로 직접 변환 안 함
        E_prior[[paste0(param, "_a")]] <- mean_val
        E_prior[[paste0(param, "_b")]] <- sd_val
      } else if (dist == "Normal") {
        E_prior[[paste0(param, "_mean")]] <- mean_val
        E_prior[[paste0(param, "_sd")]] <- sd_val
      }
    }

    ## Toxicity 파라미터 처리
    if (param %in% c("a0", "a1")) {
      if (dist == "Uniform") {
        T_prior[[paste0(param, "_min")]] <- mean_val
        T_prior[[paste0(param, "_max")]] <- sd_val
      } else if (dist == "Normal") {
        T_prior[[paste0(param, "_mean")]] <- mean_val
        T_prior[[paste0(param, "_sd")]] <- sd_val
      }
    }
  }

  return(list(E_prior = E_prior, T_prior = T_prior))
}

```

```{r}
for (p in prior_ids) {
  prior_key <- paste0("prior", p)

.get_prior_label <- function(prior_id) {
  lab <- c("1" = "strong", "2" = "weak", "3" = "non")[as.character(prior_id)]
  if (is.na(lab)) lab <- paste0("prior", prior_id)
  lab
}


process_scenario <- function(scenario_name, prior_id, sim_objects) {

  prior_key   <- paste0("prior", prior_id)       # "prior1" / "prior2" / "prior3"
  prior_label <- .get_prior_label(prior_id)      # "strong inf" / "weak inf" / "non inf"

  sim_obj <- sim_objects[[prior_key]][[scenario_name]]
  data <- sim_obj$data


  sim <- sim_obj
  scenario_results <- data.frame()

  for (combined_model_name in names(combinations)) {
    stage1_model <- combinations[[combined_model_name]]$stage1_model
    stage2_model <- combinations[[combined_model_name]]$stage2_model

    message("시나리오 ", scenario_name,
            " | 모델 ", combined_model_name,
            " | prior ", prior_key, " (", prior_label, ") 실행 중...")

    result <- run_simulation_stage(
      para, data, sim_obj, stage1_model, stage2_model)
    output <- check_performance(para, sim_obj, result)

    result_row <- data.frame(
      Scenario = scenario_name,
      Model    = combined_model_name,
      Prior    = prior_label,
      PCS      = output$PCS,
      TR_mean  = output$TR_mean,
      TR_std   = output$TR_std,
      early_stop = output$early_stop,
      select_OBD_stage1 = paste(output$stage1_counts, collapse = ", "),
      select_OBD_stage2 = if (!is.null(output$stage2_counts))
                            paste(output$stage2_counts, collapse = ", ")
                          else "NULL",
      BF_num = output$BF_num,
      n_stage1 = output$stage1_n,
      n_stage2 = if (!is.null(output$stage2_n)) output$stage2_n else "NULL",
      TR_per_dose = paste(output$TR_per_dose, collapse = ", "),
      OBD = paste(sim$OBD, collapse = ", "),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    message(paste(result_row, collapse = " "), "\n")
    scenario_results <- rbind(scenario_results, result_row)
  }

  return(scenario_results)
}
```

#결과 plot 

```{r}

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(gt)
library(gridExtra)
library(webshot2)   # PNG 저장용
# library(purrr)  # 안 써도 되게 for-loop로 변경
infile <- "2000_Test_Hill.csv"
scenario_focus <- NULL

# ====== 불러오기/가공 ======
raw <- readr::read_csv(infile, show_col_types = FALSE)
df0 <- raw
if (!is.null(scenario_focus)) df0 <- df0 %>% dplyr::filter(Scenario == scenario_focus)

# ★ 엑셀(원본) 등장 순서대로 레벨 고정용 벡터
prior_levels <- unique(as.character(df0$Prior))

n1  <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df0$n_stage1))
n2  <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df0$n_stage2)); n2[is.na(n2)] <- 0
TRm <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df0$TR_mean))
TRs <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df0$TR_std))

df <- df0 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    PriorName = as.character(Prior),
    N_total   = n1 + n2,
    PCS       = ifelse(PCS <= 1, PCS * 100, PCS),
    PTR_mean  = 100 * TRm ,
    PTR_sd    = 100 * TRs,
    Model     = as.character(Model)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Scenario, PriorName, Model) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    PCS = mean(PCS, na.rm = TRUE),
    PTR_mean = mean(PTR_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    PTR_sd   = sqrt(mean(PTR_sd^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # ★ 여기서 factor 레벨을 원본 순서로 고정
  dplyr::mutate(PriorName = factor(PriorName, levels = prior_levels, ordered = TRUE))

df_best <- df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Scenario, PriorName) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    best_PCS = PCS == max(PCS, na.rm = TRUE),
    best_PTR = PTR_mean == max(PTR_mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# ====== 그래프 (값 라벨 제거, 가로 길이 = 시나리오 수 비례) ======
n_scen <- length(unique(df_best$Scenario))
plot_width_in  <- max(12, 1.9 * n_scen)
plot_height_in <- 8

p_pcs <- ggplot(df, aes(x = PriorName, y = PCS, fill = Model)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Percent of Correct Selection (PCS)", x = "Prior", y = "Percent") +
  facet_wrap(~Scenario, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

p_ptr <- ggplot(df, aes(x = PriorName, y = PTR_mean, color = Model)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = PTR_mean - PTR_sd, ymax = PTR_mean + PTR_sd),
                width = 0, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), size = 2.8) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Percent of Patients Treated at OBD (PTR)", x = "Prior", y = "Percent") +
  facet_wrap(~Scenario, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

plot_combined <- gridExtra::arrangeGrob(p_pcs, p_ptr, ncol = 1, heights = c(1, 1.05))
ggsave("PCS_PTR_summary.png", plot_combined, width = plot_width_in, height = plot_height_in, dpi = 300)


####################################

# 표시 문자열
df_fmt <- df_best %>%
  mutate(
    PCS_val = sprintf("%.2f", PCS),
    PTR_val = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f", PTR_mean, PTR_sd)
  ) %>%
  select(Scenario, Model, PriorName, PCS_val, PTR_val, best_PCS, best_PTR)

# Prior 목록(원하는 정렬 순서로 재정의 가능)
priors <- df_fmt %>% pull(PriorName) %>% unique() %>% as.character()

# ==== 2) 열을 [Prior: PCS, PTR] 순으로 "인터리브"해서 wide ====
make_block <- function(metric_col, value_name) {
  df_fmt %>%
    select(Scenario, Model, PriorName, {{ metric_col }}) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = PriorName, values_from = {{ metric_col }}, values_fill = "") %>%
    # 열 이름: non_PCS, strong_PCS ...
    rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_", value_name), setdiff(names(.), c("Scenario","Model")))
}

pcs_wide <- make_block(PCS_val, "PCS")
ptr_wide <- make_block(PTR_val, "PTR")

# 인터리브(Scenario, Model 이후: p1_PCS, p1_PTR, p2_PCS, p2_PTR, ...)
interleave_cols <- c("Scenario", "Model")
for (p in priors) interleave_cols <- c(interleave_cols, paste0(p, "_PCS"), paste0(p, "_PTR"))

wide_interleaved <- full_join(pcs_wide, ptr_wide, by = c("Scenario","Model")) %>%
  select(any_of(interleave_cols)) %>%
  arrange(Scenario, Model)

# ==== 3) CSV 저장용(엑셀 가독 헤더) ====
csv_colnames <- c("Scenario","Model")
for (p in priors) csv_colnames <- c(csv_colnames,
                                    paste0(p, " | PCS (%)"),
                                    paste0(p, " | PTR mean±sd (%)"))
wide_csv <- wide_interleaved
names(wide_csv) <- csv_colnames

dir.create("tables", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
wide_csv_ascii <- wide_csv
names(wide_csv_ascii) <- sub("±", "+/-", names(wide_csv_ascii), fixed = TRUE)
wide_csv_ascii[] <- lapply(wide_csv_ascii, function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) sub("±", "+/-", x, fixed = TRUE) else x
})

# UTF-8 BOM 넣어 저장 (readr 사용: Excel 친화)
readr::write_excel_csv(wide_csv_ascii, file = file.path("tables", "ALL_SCENARIOS_table_ascii.csv"))

# ==== 4) PNG용 이중헤더(스패너) 만들기 ====
# 하위(두번째) 헤더 텍스트는 "PCS (%)", "PTR mean±sd (%)"
png_colnames <- c("Scenario","Model")
for (p in priors) png_colnames <- c(png_colnames, "PCS (%)", "PTR mean±sd (%)")
disp_tbl <- wide_interleaved
names(disp_tbl) <- png_colnames

# Bold 적용을 위한 매트릭스 (core 셀 기준)
fontface_mat <- matrix("plain", nrow = nrow(disp_tbl), ncol = ncol(disp_tbl))
colnames(fontface_mat) <- names(disp_tbl)

# (Scenario, Prior)별로 최고값 위치 찾아서 Bold 지정
for (sc in unique(df_fmt$Scenario)) {
  for (p in priors) {
    # PCS
    idx_pcs <- which(df_fmt$Scenario == sc & df_fmt$PriorName == p & df_fmt$best_PCS)
    if (length(idx_pcs) > 0) {
      rows <- which(disp_tbl$Scenario == sc &
                    disp_tbl$Model %in% df_fmt$Model[idx_pcs])
      colname <- "PCS (%)"
      # 해당 prior가 차지하는 2열 블록의 첫번째가 PCS
      # 블록 시작 컬럼 인덱스 구하기
      start_j <- match("Model", names(disp_tbl)) + 2 * (match(p, priors) - 1) + 1
      fontface_mat[rows, start_j] <- "bold"
    }
    # PTR
    idx_ptr <- which(df_fmt$Scenario == sc & df_fmt$PriorName == p & df_fmt$best_PTR)
    if (length(idx_ptr) > 0) {
      rows <- which(disp_tbl$Scenario == sc &
                    disp_tbl$Model %in% df_fmt$Model[idx_ptr])
      start_j <- match("Model", names(disp_tbl)) + 2 * (match(p, priors) - 1) + 1
      fontface_mat[rows, start_j + 1] <- "bold"
    }
  }
}

# 기본 테이블 grob (하위 헤더 = PCS/PTR)
tg <- gridExtra::tableGrob(
  disp_tbl,
  rows = NULL,
  theme = gridExtra::ttheme_minimal(
    core    = list(fg_params = list(cex = 0.9)),
    colhead = list(fg_params = list(fontface = 2, cex = 0.95)), # 하위 헤더 Bold
    rowhead = list(fg_params = list(fontface = 2, cex = 0.95))
  )
)

# core Bold 적용
nR <- nrow(disp_tbl); nC <- ncol(disp_tbl)
for (i in seq_len(nR)) {
  for (j in seq_len(nC)) {
    nm  <- sprintf("core-%d-%d", i, j)
    idx <- which(tg$layout$name == nm)
    if (length(idx) == 1) {
      g <- tg$grobs[[idx]]
      if (!is.null(g$children)) {
        txt_idx <- which(grepl("text", names(g$children)))
        if (length(txt_idx) >= 1) {
          g$children[[txt_idx[1]]]$gp <- grid::gpar(
            fontface = ifelse(fontface_mat[i, j] == "bold", 2, 1),
            fontsize = 9
          )
        }
      } else if (inherits(g, "text")) {
        g$gp <- grid::gpar(
          fontface = ifelse(fontface_mat[i, j] == "bold", 2, 1),
          fontsize = 9
        )
      }
      tg$grobs[[idx]] <- g
    }
  }
}

# === 상단 1줄: Prior 스패너 추가 ===
# 1) 테이블 맨 위에 행 하나 추가(스패너용)
tg <- gtable::gtable_add_rows(tg, heights = grid::unit(1.4, "lines"), pos = 0)

# --- 각 prior에 대해 2열(PCS, PTR) 범위 덮는 스패너 텍스트 추가 ---
for (k in seq_along(priors)) {
  pr <- priors[k]
  j1 <- 2 + (k - 1) * 2 + 1    # PCS 열 인덱스
  j2 <- j1 + 1                 # PTR 열 인덱스

  # 해당 헤더 셀들의 좌/우 경계 찾기 (여러개면 첫/마지막만 사용)
  l_vec <- tg$layout$l[tg$layout$name == sprintf("colhead-1-%d", j1)]
  r_vec <- tg$layout$r[tg$layout$name == sprintf("colhead-1-%d", j2)]
  if (length(l_vec) == 0 || length(r_vec) == 0) next
  l <- min(l_vec); r <- max(r_vec)

  tg <- gtable::gtable_add_grob(
    tg,
    grobs = grid::textGrob(pr, gp = grid::gpar(fontface = 2)),
    t = 1, l = l, b = 1, r = r
  )
}

# (선택) Scenario/Model 위도 스패너 넣고 싶다면:
# l_sc <- tg$layout$l[which(tg$layout$name == "colhead-1-1")]
# r_sc <- tg$layout$r[which(tg$layout$name == "colhead-1-2")]
# tg <- gtable::gtable_add_grob(tg, grid::textGrob(""), t=1,l=l_sc,b=1,r=r_sc)

# ==== 5) 저장 ====
n_priors <- length(priors)
png_width  <- max(1600, 500 + 520 * n_priors)
png_height <- max(900,  60  * (nrow(disp_tbl) + 7))

dir.create("tables", showWarnings = FALSE)
png(file.path("tables", "ALL_SCENARIOS_table.png"),
    width = png_width, height = png_height, res = 150)
grid::grid.newpage(); grid::grid.draw(tg); dev.off()

message("완료: tables/ALL_SCENARIOS_table.png / .csv 저장됨")
```

# Posterior Test 
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
source("./Function_ver2/UBLRM_Model.R") 
source("./Function_ver2/Make_data.R") 

set.seed(20250821)

J              <- para$J
DLT_target     <- para$DLT
eff_threshold  <- 0.20
n_per_dose     <- c(6,4,3,2,1)
n_realizations <- 100
scenario_name <-"S1"
priors <- get_priors(prior_table, scenario_name, candidate_num = 1)
T_prior <- priors$T_prior
E_prior <- priors$E_prior
## outcome_table → (n00,n01,n10,n11)로 1회 데이터 만들기
make_one_realization_data <- function(outcome_table, n_per_dose, J) {
  tox_rows <- paste0("Toxicity_Dose_", 1:J)
  eff_rows <- paste0("Efficacy_Dose_", 1:J)
  stopifnot(all(tox_rows %in% rownames(outcome_table)),
            all(eff_rows %in% rownames(outcome_table)))
  counts_list <- lapply(1:J, function(j) {
    tvec <- as.numeric(outcome_table[tox_rows[j], , drop = TRUE])
    evec <- as.numeric(outcome_table[eff_rows[j], , drop = TRUE])
    ok   <- which(!is.na(tvec) & !is.na(evec))
    pick <- sample(ok, size = n_per_dose[j], replace = FALSE)
    tsel <- tvec[pick]; esel <- evec[pick]
    c(
      n00 = sum(tsel == 0 & esel == 0),
      n01 = sum(tsel == 0 & esel == 1),
      n10 = sum(tsel == 1 & esel == 0),
      n11 = sum(tsel == 1 & esel == 1)
    )
  })
  mat <- do.call(rbind, counts_list)
  df  <- as.data.frame(mat)
  df$dose <- 1:J
  df$npt  <- rowSums(df[, c("n00","n01","n10","n11")])
  df[, c("dose","n00","n01","n10","n11","npt")]
}



## 저장용: realization x J
tox_q05 <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_realizations, ncol = J)
tox_q50 <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_realizations, ncol = J)
tox_q95 <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_realizations, ncol = J)

eff_q05 <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_realizations, ncol = J)
eff_q50 <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_realizations, ncol = J)
eff_q95 <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_realizations, ncol = J)

colnames(tox_q05) <- colnames(tox_q50) <- colnames(tox_q95) <- paste0("dose", 1:J)
colnames(eff_q05) <- colnames(eff_q50) <- colnames(eff_q95) <- paste0("dose", 1:J)

## 메인 루프: realization 10,000회


scenario <- scenarios[[scenario_name]]

    

for (r in 1:n_realizations) {
  # 1) 데이터 생성(각 용량 5명)
  a <- generate_toxicity_efficacy_time(scenario, 80)
  outcome_table <- a$outcome_table
  data_r <- make_one_realization_data(outcome_table, n_per_dose = n_per_dose, J = J)

  # 2) 모델 적합 (seed만 변화)
  fit_r <- UBLRM_model_fit_function(
    para    = para,
    data    = data_r,
    T_prior = T_prior,
    E_prior = E_prior,
    thin    = 2,
    seed    = 123 + r
  )

  # 3) posterior draws (iter x J) → nsamp_keep = 2000으로 정규화
  stopifnot(is.matrix(fit_r$tox_sample), is.matrix(fit_r$eff_sample))
  tox_draws <- fit_r$tox_sample
  eff_draws <- fit_r$eff_sample

  # 4) 용량별 q05/q50/q95 계산
  tox_qs <- apply(tox_draws, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95))
  eff_qs <- apply(eff_draws, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95))

  tox_q05[r, ] <- tox_qs[1, ]
  tox_q50[r, ] <- tox_qs[2, ]
  tox_q95[r, ] <- tox_qs[3, ]

  eff_q05[r, ] <- eff_qs[1, ]
  eff_q50[r, ] <- eff_qs[2, ]
  eff_q95[r, ] <- eff_qs[3, ]

  if (r %% 100 == 0) cat("realization", r, "완료\n")
}
```

```{r}
## --- 그림 1: Median plot (q50 분포: 95% 구간 ribbon + 중앙선), 참값 점 표시 ---
# 용량별로 1만개의 q50 분포 요약

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

## ---- 0) 완료된 realization 수 자동 추정 & 부분 행렬 만들기 ----
infer_done_n <- function(mat) {
  if (is.null(mat)) return(0L)
  # '전부 NA인 행'이 처음 나타나는 지점 전까지를 완료로 간주
  all_na_row <- which(apply(mat, 1, function(r) all(is.na(r))))
  if (length(all_na_row) == 0) {
    # 끝까지 값이 있거나 일부 NA 섞여 있어도 nrow(mat)까지 시도
    return(nrow(mat))
  } else {
    return(max(0L, min(all_na_row) - 1L))
  }
}

done_n <- min(
  infer_done_n(tox_q05),
  infer_done_n(tox_q50),
  infer_done_n(tox_q95),
  infer_done_n(eff_q05),
  infer_done_n(eff_q50),
  infer_done_n(eff_q95)
)

if (done_n <= 0) stop("완료된 realization이 없습니다. 루프를 조금 더 돌린 뒤 다시 시도하세요.")
message(sprintf("완료된 realization %d개로 요약/플롯을 생성합니다.", done_n))

# 부분 행렬(완료분만 사용)
tox_q05_part <- tox_q05[1:done_n, , drop = FALSE]
tox_q50_part <- tox_q50[1:done_n, , drop = FALSE]
tox_q95_part <- tox_q95[1:done_n, , drop = FALSE]
eff_q05_part <- eff_q05[1:done_n, , drop = FALSE]
eff_q50_part <- eff_q50[1:done_n, , drop = FALSE]
eff_q95_part <- eff_q95[1:done_n, , drop = FALSE]

## ---- 1) Median plot용 요약 (q50의 분포) ----
summ_median <- tibble(
  dose        = 1:J,
  tox_med_med = apply(tox_q50_part, 2, median,                  na.rm = TRUE),
  tox_med_lo  = apply(tox_q50_part, 2, quantile, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
  tox_med_hi  = apply(tox_q50_part, 2, quantile, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
  eff_med_med = apply(eff_q50_part, 2, median,                  na.rm = TRUE),
  eff_med_lo  = apply(eff_q50_part, 2, quantile, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
  eff_med_hi  = apply(eff_q50_part, 2, quantile, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
  true_T      = as.numeric(scenario$pi_T),
  true_E      = as.numeric(scenario$pi_E)
)

df_median <- bind_rows(
  summ_median %>% transmute(dose, stat = "tox", mid = tox_med_med, lo = tox_med_lo, hi = tox_med_hi, true = true_T),
  summ_median %>% transmute(dose, stat = "eff", mid = eff_med_med, lo = eff_med_lo, hi = eff_med_hi, true = true_E)
)

# 색상/범례 꼬임 방지용 (순서 고정)
df_median$stat <- factor(df_median$stat, levels = c("tox","eff"))

p_median <- ggplot(df_median, aes(x = dose, y = mid, color = stat, fill = stat, group = stat)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = true), size = 2, shape = 16) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("tox" = "blue", "eff" = "red"),
    breaks = c("tox","eff"),
    labels = c("Toxicity","Efficacy"),
    name   = NULL
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("tox" = "blue", "eff" = "red"), breaks = c("tox","eff"), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:J) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,1)) +
  labs(
    title    = sprintf("Distribution of median (q50) across %s realizations", format(done_n, big.mark=",")),
    subtitle = "Ribbon: 95% interval of medians; Line: median of medians",
    x = "Dose level", y = "Probability"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

print(p_median)

## ---- 2) Tails plot 데이터 만들기 (tox: q95만, eff: q05만 표시) ----
summ_tails <- tibble(dose = 1:J) %>%
  mutate(
    tox_q05_med = apply(tox_q05_part, 2, median,                  na.rm = TRUE),
    tox_q05_lo  = apply(tox_q05_part, 2, quantile, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    tox_q05_hi  = apply(tox_q05_part, 2, quantile, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    tox_q95_med = apply(tox_q95_part, 2, median,                  na.rm = TRUE),
    tox_q95_lo  = apply(tox_q95_part, 2, quantile, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    tox_q95_hi  = apply(tox_q95_part, 2, quantile, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),

    eff_q05_med = apply(eff_q05_part, 2, median,                  na.rm = TRUE),
    eff_q05_lo  = apply(eff_q05_part, 2, quantile, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    eff_q05_hi  = apply(eff_q05_part, 2, quantile, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    eff_q95_med = apply(eff_q95_part, 2, median,                  na.rm = TRUE),
    eff_q95_lo  = apply(eff_q95_part, 2, quantile, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    eff_q95_hi  = apply(eff_q95_part, 2, quantile, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    true_T      = as.numeric(scenario$pi_T),
    true_E      = as.numeric(scenario$pi_E)
  )

df_tails <- bind_rows(
  summ_tails %>% transmute(dose, stat = "tox", qtype = "q05", mid = tox_q05_med, lo = tox_q05_lo, hi = tox_q05_hi, true = true_T),
  summ_tails %>% transmute(dose, stat = "tox", qtype = "q95", mid = tox_q95_med, lo = tox_q95_lo, hi = tox_q95_hi, true = true_T),
  summ_tails %>% transmute(dose, stat = "eff", qtype = "q05", mid = eff_q05_med, lo = eff_q05_lo, hi = eff_q05_hi, true = true_E),
  summ_tails %>% transmute(dose, stat = "eff", qtype = "q95", mid = eff_q95_med, lo = eff_q95_lo, hi = eff_q95_hi, true = true_E)
)

# 필요한 것만: tox=q95, eff=q05
tails_subset <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  df_tails %>% dplyr::filter(stat == "tox", qtype == "q05"),
  df_tails %>% dplyr::filter(stat == "eff", qtype == "q95")
)
tails_subset$stat <- factor(tails_subset$stat, levels = c("tox","eff"))

## ---- 3) Tails plot (linetype 범례 제거, 수평선 2개만, 파랑/빨강) ----
p_tails <- ggplot(
  tails_subset,
  aes(x = dose, y = mid, color = stat, fill = stat, group = stat)
) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), alpha = 0.12, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = DLT_target + 0.05, linetype = "dotted",  color = "blue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = eff_threshold,    linetype = "dotdash", color = "red",  linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("tox" = "blue", "eff" = "red"),
    breaks = c("tox","eff"),
    labels = c("Toxicity (q05)", "Efficacy (q95)"),
    name   = NULL
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("tox" = "blue", "eff" = "red"), breaks = c("tox","eff"), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:J) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,1)) +
  labs(
    title    = sprintf("Tails across %s realizations (tox: q05 only, eff: q95 only)", format(done_n, big.mark=",")),
    subtitle = "Ribbon: 95% interval across realizations; Blue dotted: DLT+0.05; Red dotdash: Eff=0.2",
    x = "Dose level", y = "Probability"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

print(p_tails)



## ---- TOX q05 & EFF q95 기준 충족 개수/비율 표 ----
# 안전 체크 (필요 행렬 존재 여부)
stopifnot(exists("tox_q05_part"), exists("eff_q95_part"), exists("done_n"))

tox_cut   <- DLT_target + 0.05
eff_cut   <- eff_threshold

tox_q05_gt_cut_count <- colSums(tox_q05_part >  tox_cut, na.rm = TRUE)
tox_q05_gt_cut_rate  <- tox_q05_gt_cut_count / done_n

eff_q95_lt_cut_count <- colSums(eff_q95_part < eff_cut, na.rm = TRUE)
eff_q95_lt_cut_rate  <- eff_q95_lt_cut_count / done_n

summary_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
  dose = 1:J,
  tox_q05_gt_DLTp005_n   = as.integer(tox_q05_gt_cut_count),
  tox_q05_gt_DLTp005_pct = round(100 * tox_q05_gt_cut_rate, 1),
  eff_q95_lt_0p2_n       = as.integer(eff_q95_lt_cut_count),
  eff_q95_lt_0p2_pct     = round(100 * eff_q95_lt_cut_rate, 1)
)

print(summary_tbl)

# 보기 좋게 포맷 (옵션)
summary_tbl_fmt <- summary_tbl %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    `tox q05 > DLT+0.05` = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", tox_q05_gt_DLTp005_n, tox_q05_gt_DLTp005_pct),
    `eff q95 < 0.20`     = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", eff_q95_lt_0p2_n,     eff_q95_lt_0p2_pct)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(dose, `tox q05 > DLT+0.05`, `eff q95 < 0.20`)

print(summary_tbl_fmt)
``` 

```{r}
N <- 5
n.dose <- 7
set.seed(123)
dose.level <- rep(c(1:n.dose), times = N)
x <- para$doses[dose.level] / para$ref_dose

# Set up true toxicity model
alpha0.true <- -1.8
alpha1.true <- 0.5
p <- 1 / (1 + exp(-(alpha0.true + alpha1.true * x)))
dt<-data.frame(x,p)
Y<-rbinom(nrow(dt),size=1,prob=dt$p)

# Fit Bayesian Toxicity model
system.time(result.tox <- Bayesian.Toxicity(
  Y = Y,
  x = dt$x,
  burn.in = 3000,
  B = 5000,
  chol = TRUE,
  T_prior = T_prior
))

# True and estimated parameters
true.params <- data.frame(alpha0.true = alpha0.true, alpha1.true = alpha1.true)
posterior.means.tox <- colMeans(result.tox)
posterior.means.tox

# Convergence check
plot(1:5000, cumsum(result.tox$alpha1)/1:5000, type = "l", ylab = "Running mean of alpha1")

# Fit probability using posterior means
p.tox.fit <- 1 / (1 + exp(-(posterior.means.tox["alpha0"] + posterior.means.tox["alpha1"] * x)))
o <- order(x)
plot(x[o], p[o], type = "l", ylab = "Toxicity Probability", xlab = "x", main = "True vs Fitted Toxicity")
points(x[o], p.tox.fit[o], type = "l", col = "red")
legend("topleft", legend = c("True", "Fitted"), col = c("black", "red"), lty = 1)
```

```{r}
x <- para$doses[dose.level] / para$ref_dose
b0.true<- -2.2; b1.true<- 3;delta0.true<-0.05;delta1.true<-0.65
p<-delta0.true+(delta1.true-delta0.true)*plogis(b0.true+b1.true*x);
dt<-data.frame(x,p)
Y<-rbinom(nrow(dt),size=1,prob=dt$p)
#####################################


#####################################
##Fit Bayesian Hill equation
#####################################
system.time(result <- Bayesian.Hill(Y=Y,x=dt$x,burn.in=5000,B=10000,unif=T,chol=T,E_prior=E_prior))
data.frame(delta0.true,delta1.true,b0.true,b1.true)
posterior.means<-colMeans(result)
posterior.means

#####################################
##Plot results
#####################################

plot(1:10000,cumsum(result$delta1)/1:10000,type="l")  #check the convergence to determine the amount of burn-in
p.fit<-posterior.means["delta0"]+(posterior.means["delta1"]-posterior.means["delta0"])*exp(posterior.means["b0"]+posterior.means["b1"]*x)/(1+exp(posterior.means["b0"]+posterior.means["b1"]*x));

o<-order(x);
plot(x[o],p[o],type="l")
points(x[o],p.fit[o],type="l",col="red")



```

```{r}
library(patchwork)
source("./Function_ver2/UBLRM_Model.R")
source("./Function_ver2/Plot.R") 

prior_table <- read_csv("파라미터_hill3.csv")

# 시나리오와 후보 목록
scenario_names <- c("S_I")
candidate_nums <- 1:4

# 결과를 저장할 리스트
plot_list <- list()
plot_index <- 1

for (scenario_name in scenario_names) {
  scenario <- scenarios[[scenario_name]]
  
  for (candidate_num in candidate_nums) {
    # Prior 및 데이터 생성
    priors <- get_priors(prior_table, scenario_name, candidate_num = candidate_num)
    T_prior <- priors$T_prior
    E_prior <- priors$E_prior
    a <- generate_toxicity_efficacy_time(scenario, 100)
    outcome_table <- a$outcome_table
    time_table <- a$time_table
    toxicity_sim <- outcome_table[grep("Tox", rownames(outcome_table)),]

    joint_probs <- disjoint(scenario$pi_T, scenario$pi_E, 0)
    total_patients <- 0
    data <- data.frame(
      dose = 1:7,
      n00 = round(joint_probs[1, ] * total_patients),
      n01 = round(joint_probs[2, ] * total_patients),
      n10 = round(joint_probs[3, ] * total_patients),
      n11 = round(joint_probs[4, ] * total_patients)
    )
    data$npt <- data$n00 + data$n01 + data$n10 + data$n11

    prob <- UBLRM_model_fit_function(para, data, T_prior, E_prior)
    result <- plot_UBLRM_fit(data, prob)
    plot <- result$plot + ggtitle(paste0( scenario_name, ", prior: ", candidate_num))

    plot_list[[plot_index]] <-suppressWarnings({ plot})
    plot_index <- plot_index + 1
  }
}

# 3x3 grid로 병합하여 출력
combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 2, nrow = 2)
suppressWarnings(print(combined_plot))
```
